translations.translatedText: # Friday 4.6.2021 (radio)
The discussion about the prime minister's breakfasts continues. Yle has held an election debate for the parties in clear language. Linnanmäki has opened. The weekend is warm.
## The prime minister's breakfasts

![Sanna Marin visiting Mikkeli on 31.5.2021. During the visit Marin met representatives of the city and the regional council.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3008,h_1692,x_0,y_193/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-81380660b5ca3b83226/1622526564)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin. Photo: Juho Liukkonen / Yle
The discussion about the prime minister's breakfasts continues.
The Tax Administration announced on Friday that tax must be paid on the prime minister's free breakfasts. Civil servants asked the Tax Administration about the matter.

Iltalehti reported earlier that the prime minister and the prime minister's family get a free breakfast at the prime minister's official residence at Kesäranta. The guidelines have, however, been unclear, and no tax has been paid on the breakfasts.
Prime Minister Sanna Marin has already said earlier that she no longer wants free breakfasts. In addition, she will pay back the sum that the state has paid for the breakfasts so far.
## Clear Debate for the municipal elections
![A woman.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11967150)
Open image viewer
The host of the Clear Debate is Margit Alasalmi. Photo: Yle
The municipal elections are soon. Election day is in about a week, that is, 13 June.
Yle has held an election debate for the parties in clear language. All 9 parties in Parliament took part in the debate.

In the Clear Debate they talked about matters that are important in the municipal elections. For example, the debate covered work, housing and school. These are matters on which people can have an influence when they vote in the municipal elections.
The politicians agreed on many matters. For example, they said that municipalities must cooperate with companies so that jobs are found for the unemployed.
Everyone also said that schools must have enough teachers and other adults so that all children learn the important basic skills.
In the Clear Debate the politicians spoke as easy Finnish as they could. A panel listened to the politicians' speech. The panel showed with a gauge whether the speech was easy or difficult.
The Clear Debate can be watched on Yle Areena.
## Linnanmäki amusement park
![Linnanmäki's old roller coaster.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_197/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5649775ce53e3973854/1558527608)
Open image viewer
Linnanmäki's roller coaster turns 70 years old. Photo: Joonas Koivisto / YLE
Linnanmäki has opened. The Linnanmäki amusement park in Helsinki opened on Friday.
Because of corona, fewer customers can get into Linnanmäki than usual. Linnanmäki also hopes that customers will wear masks.
Linnanmäki's old favourite ride is the roller coaster. The roller coaster turns 70 years old this summer.
## Weekend weather
![Weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11967158)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
The weekend is warm. In a large part of the country the temperature is about 25 degrees.
On Saturday the sun shines in most of the country. In Lapland there may be a few rain showers.
On Sunday there may also be rain showers in the south. However, in wide areas it is dry, meaning no rain falls.
